name: Messengers and Stars
source:
This visual novel was developed as part of a mandatory project at the end of high school in Switzerland. It takes the player into the far future, where they take up the role of Laleh, a young woman chosen to lead the first diplomatic summit between humanity and alien life forms. Her, and the player's, actions will determine the fate of the universe.

[From [url=https://gumroad.com/l/aNFtl]Gumroad[/url]]
